commitResults.messageTitle: Update DG design diagrams for v1.6
commitResults.messageBody:
Some Developer Guide diagrams no longer match the final code. Parser
lifelines lack activation bars or destroy markers, notes cover active
activation bars, the model and parser class diagrams still show AB3
details, and view and setoutstanding have no diagram despite having
call orders that prose alone does not show.

Let's bring the diagrams and their Design and Implementation text in
line with src/main:

* Fix the notation of the sequence diagrams, draw static method
  calls to the class, and place notes beside lifelines instead of
  over them.
* Link the wide diagrams to their full-size images, as they are too
  small to read in the guide's content column.
* Add sequence diagrams for view and setoutstanding.
* Show the save step with a literal true for commands that always
  save, and leave the check out for commands that never save.
* Explain in the DG the calls each diagram leaves out and why.
* Update the model and parser class diagrams to the current fields
  and dependencies.
* List every library and tool, with resolved versions, in the
  Acknowledgements.
* Remove AB3 leftovers, including the orphan add-remark and tracing
  tutorial diagrams that describe a nonexistent RemarkCommand.

Regenerate only the PNGs whose sources changed, plus the new ones, as
re-rendering the others with the newer PlantUML worsens some layouts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Explain the email domain rule in the email error message
commitResults.messageBody:

least 2 letters, as the User Guide already documents.
